cues.zh: 所以今天的顶级大厨课，讲的是怎么抢银行，
cues.en: So today's top chef class is in how to rob a bank,

cues.zh: 显然普通大众需要指导，
cues.en: and it's clear that the general public needs guidance,

cues.zh: 因为一般抢银行平均只抢到
cues.en: because the average bank robbery nets
only 7,500 dollars.

cues.zh: 都是些一无所知的业余选手，
cues.en: Rank amateurs who know nothing
about how to cook the books.
The folks who know, of course,

cues.zh: 经营着我们最大的银行，
cues.en: run our largest banks,
and in the last go-around,

cues.zh: 他们让我们损失了超过11万亿美元。
cues.en: they cost us over 11 trillion dollars.
That's what 11 trillion looks like.
That's how many zeros?

cues.zh: 还让我们损失了超过1000万个工作岗位。
cues.en: And cost us over 10 million jobs as well.

cues.zh: 所以我们的任务是自我教育，
cues.en: So our task is to educate ourselves
so that we can understand

cues.zh: 为什么我们会反复出现、
cues.en: why we have these recurrent,
intensifying financial crises,

cues.zh: 以及我们未来如何预防它们。
cues.en: and how we can prevent them in the future.
And the answer to that is

cues.zh: 我们必须阻止控制欺诈的流行。
cues.en: that we have to stop epidemics of control fraud.
Control fraud is what happens
when the people who control,
typically a CEO,
a seemingly legitimate entity,

cues.zh: 把它当作武器来诈骗的时候。
cues.en: use it as a weapon to defraud.

cues.zh: 这些就是大规模杀伤性武器
cues.en: And these are the weapons of mass destruction
in the financial world.

cues.zh: 它们在金融界也遵循一种特定的策略，
cues.en: They also follow in finance a particular strategy,

cues.zh: 因为金融界的首选武器
cues.en: because the weapon of choice in finance
is accounting,
and there is a recipe for accounting

cues.zh: 用于控制欺诈，以及它是如何发生的。
cues.en: control fraud, and how it occurs.
And we discovered this recipe

cues.zh: 方式相当奇特，我稍后会回头讲。
cues.en: in quite an odd way that I'll come back to in a moment.

cues.zh: 配方的第一味原料：疯狂增长；
cues.en: First ingredient in the recipe: grow like crazy;

cues.zh: 第二，通过发放或购买极其劣质的贷款，
cues.en: second, by making or buying really crappy loans,
but loans that are made at a very high interest rate
or yield;

cues.zh: 第三，同时使用极端的杠杆——
cues.en: three, while employing extreme leverage --
that just means a lot of debt --
compared to your equity;

cues.zh: 第四，同时只提供微不足道的损失准备金
cues.en: and four, while providing only trivial loss reserves

cues.zh: 来应对不可避免的损失。
cues.en: against the inevitable losses.

cues.zh: 如果你遵循这简单的四步，
cues.en: If you follow those four simple steps,
and any bank can follow them,
then you are mathematically guaranteed
to have three things occur.
The first thing is

cues.zh: 你会报告创纪录的银行利润——
cues.en: you will report record bank profits --
not just high, record.

cues.zh: 第二，CEO会立刻变得极其富有
cues.en: Two, the CEO will immediately be made incredibly wealthy
by modern executive compensation.
And three, farther down the road,

cues.zh: 银行将遭受灾难性损失
cues.en: the bank will suffer catastrophic losses

cues.zh: 并会倒闭，除非获得救助。
cues.en: and will fail unless it is bailed out.
And that's a hint as to how

cues.zh: 是如何发现这个配方的，
cues.en: we discovered this recipe,

cues.zh: 因为我们是通过解剖过程发现的。
cues.en: because we discovered it through an autopsy process.
During the savings and loan debacle in 1984,

cues.zh: 我们审视了每一家倒闭的机构，
cues.en: we looked at every single failure,
and we looked for common characteristics,

cues.zh: 结果发现这个配方普遍存在于
cues.en: and we discovered this recipe was common
to each of these frauds.

cues.zh: 换句话说，验尸官能发现这些东西
cues.en: In other words, a coroner could find these things

cues.zh: 因为这是一个致命配方
cues.en: because this is a fatal recipe
that will destroy the banks
as well as the economy.
And it also turns out to be precisely

cues.zh: 本可以阻止这场危机的东西，
cues.en: what could have stopped this crisis,

cues.zh: 这场危机仅在家庭部门
cues.en: the one that cost us 11 trillion dollars

cues.zh: 就让我们损失了11万亿美元，
cues.en: just in the household sector,

cues.zh: 让我们损失了1000万个工作岗位，
cues.en: that cost us 10 million jobs,

cues.zh: 它其实是迄今为止最容易
cues.en: was the easiest financial crisis by far

cues.zh: 被完全避免的金融危机，
cues.en: to have avoided completely
if we had simply learned the lessons

cues.zh: 控制欺诈流行病的教训，
cues.en: of epidemics of control fraud,
particularly using this recipe.

cues.zh: 那我们来谈谈这场危机，
cues.en: So let's go to this crisis,
and the two huge epidemics

cues.zh: 推动危机的贷款发放欺诈——
cues.en: of loan origination fraud that drove the crisis --
appraisal fraud and liar's loans --
and what we're going to see
in looking at both of these is

cues.zh: 我们得到的警告极其早
cues.en: we got warnings that were incredibly early
about these frauds.

cues.zh: 我们得到的警告本可以轻易利用，
cues.en: We got warnings that we could have taken advantage of easily,
because back in the savings and loan debacle,

cues.zh: 我们已经想出了如何应对
cues.en: we had figured out how to respond
and prevent these crises.

cues.zh: 第三，这些警告是明确无误的。
cues.en: And three, the warnings were unambiguous.
They were obvious that what was going on

cues.zh: 会计控制欺诈在积聚蔓延。
cues.en: was an epidemic of accounting control fraud building up.
Let's take appraisal fraud first.

cues.zh: 这无非就是抬高房屋价值
cues.en: This is simply where you inflate the value
of the home that is being pledged
as security for the loan.
In 2000, the year 2000,

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，那是在安然倒闭一年多以前，
cues.en: that is over a year before Enron fails, by the way,

cues.zh: 诚实的评估师们聚集起来，正式请愿
cues.en: the honest appraisers got together a formal petition

cues.zh: 恳求联邦政府采取行动，
cues.en: begging the federal government to act,
and the industry to act,

cues.zh: 制止这种评估欺诈的蔓延。
cues.en: to stop this epidemic of appraisal fraud.

cues.zh: 估价师解释了这是怎么发生的，
cues.en: And the appraisers explained how it was occurring,
that banks were demanding that appraisers
inflate the appraisal,

cues.zh: 如果估价师拒绝这么做，
cues.en: and that if the appraisers refused to do so,
they, the banks, would blacklist

cues.zh: 诚实的估价师列入黑名单
cues.en: honest appraisers
and refuse to use them.
Now, we've seen this before
in the savings and loan debacle,
and we know that this kind of fraud
can only originate from the lenders,

cues.zh: 没有哪个诚实的贷款方会去抬高
cues.en: and that no honest lender would ever inflate
the appraisal,

cues.zh: 因为估价是防范损失的重要保障。
cues.en: because it's the great protection against loss.

cues.zh: 所以这是极早的预警，2000年。
cues.en: So this was an incredibly early warning, 2000.
It was something we'd seen before,
and it was completely unambiguous.

cues.zh: 这是一场会计控制欺诈的流行，
cues.en: This was an epidemic of accounting control fraud
led by the banks.
What about liar's loans?

cues.zh: 这个预警其实来得更早。
cues.en: Well, that warning actually comes earlier.
The savings and loan debacle is basically

cues.zh: 从20世纪80年代初持续到1993年，
cues.en: the early 1980s through 1993,
and in the midst of fighting that wave

cues.zh: 会计操控欺诈的过程中，
cues.en: of accounting control fraud,
in 1990, we found that a second front
of fraud was being started.

cues.zh: 就像美国所有高明的金融欺诈一样，
cues.en: And like all good financial frauds in America,

cues.zh: 它始于加利福尼亚的橙县。
cues.en: it began in Orange County, California.

cues.zh: 而我们恰好是那里的区域监管者。
cues.en: And we happened to be the regional regulators for it.
And our examiners said,

cues.zh: 他们放贷时甚至不核查
cues.en: they are making loans without even checking
what the borrower's income is.

cues.zh: 这太疯狂了，必然导致巨额损失，
cues.en: This is insane, it has to lead to massive losses,
and it only makes sense for entities engaged

cues.zh: 会计操控欺诈的实体才干得出来。
cues.en: in these accounting control frauds.

cues.zh: 我们说，没错，你说得完全对，
cues.en: And we said, yeah, you're absolutely right,
and we drove those liar's loans

cues.zh: 把那些骗子贷款清出了行业，
cues.en: out of the industry in 1990 and 1991,
but we could only deal with the industry

cues.zh: 我们管辖范围内的行业，
cues.en: we had jurisdiction over,
which was savings and loans,

cues.zh: 于是那些最大最恶劣的欺诈者，
cues.en: and so the biggest and the baddest of the frauds,
Long Beach Savings, voluntarily gave up
its federal savings and loan charter,
gave up federal deposit insurance,

cues.zh: 转型成为一家抵押银行，
cues.en: converted to become a mortgage bank

cues.zh: 唯一目的就是逃脱我们的管辖，
cues.en: for the sole purpose of escaping our jurisdiction,
and changed its name to Ameriquest,

cues.zh: 早期成了最臭名昭著的
cues.en: and became the most notorious
of the liar's loans frauds early on,
and to add to that,

cues.zh: 他们故意针对少数族裔下手。
cues.en: they deliberately predated upon minorities.

cues.zh: 所以我们对这场危机又有所了解。
cues.en: So we knew again about this crisis.

cues.zh: 我们以前见过它。我们以前阻止过它。
cues.en: We'd seen it before. We'd stopped it before.

cues.zh: 我们得到了令人难以置信的早期预警，
cues.en: We had incredibly early warnings of it,
and it was absolutely unambiguous

cues.zh: 没有诚实的贷款人会以这种方式发放贷款。
cues.en: that no honest lender would make loans in this fashion.

cues.zh: 那么让我们看看各方的反应
cues.en: So let's take a look at the reaction
of the industry and the regulators

cues.zh: 和检察官对这些明确的
cues.en: and the prosecutors to these clear

cues.zh: 本可阻止危机的早期预警的反应。
cues.en: early warnings that could have prevented the crisis.
Start with the industry.
The industry responded between 2003 and 2006
by increasing liar's loans
by over 500 percent.
These were the loans
that hyperinflated the bubble
and produced the economic crisis.

cues.zh: 到2006年，所有被称为次级的贷款中有一半
cues.en: By 2006, half of all the loans called subprime
were also liar's loans.

cues.zh: 它们并不互斥，只是合在一起，
cues.en: They're not mutually exclusive, it's just that together,
they're the most toxic combination
you can possibly imagine.
By 2006, 40 percent of all the loans

cues.zh: 有40%，当年所有住房贷款中，
cues.en: made that year, all the home loans made that year,
were liar's loans,
40 percent.

cues.zh: 而这是在该行业自己的反欺诈专家
cues.en: And this is despite a warning

cues.zh: 发出警告的情况下发生的
cues.en: from the industry's own antifraud experts

cues.zh: 专家说这些贷款等于公开邀请
cues.en: that said that these loans were an open invitation
to fraudsters,

cues.zh: 而且这类贷款的欺诈发生率
cues.en: and that they had a fraud incidence
of 90 percent,
nine zero.
In response to that, the industry

cues.zh: 首先开始把这些贷款叫做骗子贷款，
cues.en: first started calling these loans liar's loans,
which lacks a certain subtlety,

cues.zh: 其次，大幅增加了这类贷款，
cues.en: and second, massively increased them,

cues.zh: 而没有任何政府监管机构
cues.en: and no government regulator ever

cues.zh: 要求或鼓励任何贷款机构
cues.en: required or encouraged any lender
to make a liar's loan

cues.zh: 或任何人购买骗子贷款，
cues.en: or anyone to purchase a liar's loan,

cues.zh: 这明确包括房利美和房地美。
cues.en: and that explicitly includes Fannie and Freddie.
This came from the lenders
because of the fraud recipe.

cues.zh: 评估欺诈后来怎么样了？
cues.en: What happened to appraisal fraud?
It expanded remarkably as well.

cues.zh: 到2007年，对评估师进行的一项调查显示，
cues.en: By 2007, when a survey of appraisers was done,
90 percent of appraisers reported
that they had been subject to coercion

cues.zh: 来自贷款方，试图让他们
cues.en: from the lenders trying to get them
to inflate an appraisal.

cues.zh: 换句话说，两种形式的欺诈
cues.en: In other words, both forms of fraud
became absolutely endemic and normal,

cues.zh: 而这正是推动泡沫的原因。
cues.en: and this is what drove the bubble.
What happened in the governmental sector?

cues.zh: 嗯，政府，正如我告诉你的，
cues.en: Well, the government, as I told you,

cues.zh: 当我们是储蓄和贷款监管者时，
cues.en: when we were the savings and loan regulators,

cues.zh: 我们只能处理我们自己的行业，
cues.en: we could only deal with our industry,

cues.zh: 如果人们放弃了他们的联邦存款保险，
cues.en: and if people gave up their federal deposit insurance,
we couldn't do anything to them.

cues.zh: 国会，可能让你觉得不可能，
cues.en: Congress, it may strike you as impossible,

cues.zh: 但实际上在1994年做了一件明智的事，
cues.en: but actually did something intelligent in 1994,

cues.zh: 通过了《住房所有权和股权保护法》
cues.en: and passed the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act

cues.zh: 赋予美联储，且只有美联储，
cues.en: that gave the Fed, and only the Federal Reserve,

cues.zh: 明确的法定权力来禁止骗子贷款
cues.en: the explicit, statutory authority to ban liar's loans
by every lender,

cues.zh: 无论他们是否有联邦存款保险。
cues.en: whether or not they had federal deposit insurance.

cues.zh: 那么，作为美联储主席，Ben Bernanke 和 Alan Greenspan
cues.en: So what did Ben Bernanke and Alan Greenspan,
as chairs of the Fed, do
when they got these warnings

cues.zh: 这些警告指出，这些贷款存在大规模欺诈
cues.en: that these were massively fraudulent loans

cues.zh: 并且正被出售到二级市场？
cues.en: and that they were being sold to the secondary market?

cues.zh: 记住，世上没有驱魔人能把欺诈驱走。
cues.en: Remember, there's no fraud exorcist.

cues.zh: 一旦一笔贷款从一开始就是欺诈性的，
cues.en: Once it starts out a fraudulent loan,

cues.zh: 它只能通过更多的欺诈
cues.en: it can only be sold to the secondary market
through more frauds,
lying about the reps and warrantees,
and then those people are going to produce
mortgage-backed securities
and exotic derivatives
which are also going to be supposedly backed

cues.zh: 那些欺诈性贷款支持的。
cues.en: by those fraudulent loans.
So the fraud is going to progress
through the entire system,

cues.zh: 把泡沫吹得极度膨胀，酿成一场灾难。
cues.en: hyperinflate the bubble, produce a disaster.

cues.zh: 记住，我们对此有过经验。
cues.en: And remember, we had experience with this.
We had seen significant losses,
and we had experience of competent regulators
in stopping it.
Greenspan and Bernanke refused
to use the authority under the statute
to stop liar's loans.
And this was a matter first of dogma.
They're just horrifically opposed
to anything regulatory.

cues.zh: 但这也是国际上的宽松竞争，
cues.en: But it is also the international competition in laxity,
the race to the bottom
between the United States and the United Kingdom,
the city of London, in particular,

cues.zh: 而伦敦金融城赢得了这场逐底竞赛，
cues.en: and the city of London won that race to the bottom,

cues.zh: 但这意味着西方的所有监管
cues.en: but it meant that all regulation in the West
was completely degraded
in this stupid competition to be

cues.zh: 看谁能拥有最弱的监管。
cues.en: who could have the weakest regulation.

cues.zh: 这就是监管层面的回应。
cues.en: So that was the regulatory response.
What about the response of the prosecutors
after the crisis,
after 11 trillion dollars in losses,

cues.zh: 在失去1000万个工作岗位之后，
cues.en: after 10 million jobs lost,

cues.zh: 这场危机中的损失和欺诈
cues.en: a crisis in which the losses and the frauds
were more than 70 times larger
than the savings and loan debacle?
Well, in the savings and loan debacle,

cues.zh: 我们监管储贷机构的部门，OTS，
cues.en: our agency that regulated savings and loans, OTS,

cues.zh: 提交了超过3万份刑事移送，
cues.en: made over 30,000 criminal referrals,

cues.zh: 促成了超过1000起重罪定罪，
cues.en: produced over 1,000 felony convictions

cues.zh: 这还只是被列为重大案件的部分，
cues.en: just in cases designated as major,

cues.zh: 而这还低估了优先处理的力度，
cues.en: and that understates the degree of prioritization,
because we worked with the FBI

cues.zh: 制定了全国百大欺诈案清单，
cues.en: to create the list of the top 100 fraud schemes,

cues.zh: 绝对是最恶劣中的最恶劣。
cues.en: the absolute worst of the worst, nationwide.
Roughly 300 savings and loans involved,
roughly 600 senior officials.
Virtually all of them were prosecuted.
We had a 90 percent conviction rate.
It's the greatest success against

cues.zh: 对精英白领罪犯最成功的一次打击，
cues.en: elite white collar criminals ever,
and it was because of this understanding
of control fraud

cues.zh: 以及会计控制欺诈机制的理解。
cues.en: and the accounting control fraud mechanism.
Flash forward to the current crisis.

cues.zh: 同一个机构，储蓄机构监理局，
cues.en: The same agency, Office of Thrift Supervision,
which was supposed to regulate

cues.zh: 国内许多最大的骗子贷款发放机构，
cues.en: many of the largest makers of liar's loans
in the country,

cues.zh: 时至今日——它已不复存在，
cues.en: has made, even today -- it no longer exists,
but as of a year ago,

cues.zh: 它提出的刑事移送数量为零。
cues.en: it had made zero criminal referrals.
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency,

cues.zh: 本应监管最大的全国性银行，
cues.en: which is supposed to regulate the largest national banks,

cues.zh: 提出的刑事移送数量为零。
cues.en: has made zero criminal referrals.
The Fed appears to have made
zero criminal referrals.
The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation

cues.zh: 很聪明，拒绝回答这个问题。
cues.en: is smart enough to refuse to answer the question.

cues.zh: 没有任何来自监管机构的指导，
cues.en: Without any guidance from the regulators,
there's no expertise in the FBI
to investigate complex frauds.

cues.zh: 这不仅仅是他们不得不
cues.en: It isn't simply that they've had
to reinvent the wheel
of how to do these prosecutions;
they've forgotten that the wheel exists,

cues.zh: 因此，我们没有任何起诉，
cues.en: and therefore, we have zero prosecutions,
and of course, zero convictions,

cues.zh: 针对任何精英阶层的银行欺诈，
cues.en: of any of the elite bank frauds,
the Wall Street types,

cues.zh: 正是他们推动了这场危机。
cues.en: that drove this crisis.

cues.zh: 监管机构毫无专业能力，
cues.en: With no expertise coming from the regulators,

cues.zh: FBI 在 2007 年与抵押贷款银行家协会
cues.en: the FBI formed what it calls a partnership

cues.zh: 建立了所谓的合作关系。
cues.en: with the Mortgage Bankers Association in 2007.
The Mortgage Bankers Association

cues.zh: 就是这些罪犯的行业协会。
cues.en: is the trade association of the perps.

cues.zh: 而抵押贷款银行家协会
cues.en: And the Mortgage Bankers Association
set out, it had the audacity and the success
to con the FBI.
It had created a supposed definition

cues.zh: 抵押贷款欺诈定义，你猜怎么着，
cues.en: of mortgage fraud, in which, guess what,

cues.zh: 它的成员永远是受害者
cues.en: its members are always the victim
and never the perpetrators.
And the FBI has bought this hook, line, sinker,

cues.zh: 连鱼竿、鱼线、船都一并信了。
cues.en: rod, reel and the boat they rode out in.
And so the FBI,

cues.zh: 在一名司法部长的领导下
cues.en: under the leadership of an attorney general
who is African-American

cues.zh: 以及一位非裔美国总统，
cues.en: and a president of the United States who is African-American,

cues.zh: 采纳了茶党对这场危机的定义，
cues.en: have adopted the Tea Party definition of the crisis,

cues.zh: 其中这是历史上第一场纯洁的危机，
cues.en: in which it is the first virgin crisis in history,

cues.zh: 在行政层级的孕育中毫无罪过。
cues.en: conceived without sin in the executive ranks.

cues.zh: 就是那些自以为聪明的理发师
cues.en: And it's those oh-so-clever hairdressers

cues.zh: 他们竟然骗过了那些可怜又可悲的银行，
cues.en: who were able to defraud the poor, pitiful banks,

cues.zh: 那些对金融一窍不通的银行。
cues.en: who lack any financial sophistication.

cues.zh: 这故事荒唐得不能再荒唐了，
cues.en: It is the silliest story you can conceive of,

cues.zh: 结果他们反倒去起诉那些理发师，
cues.en: and so they go and they prosecute the hairdressers,

cues.zh: 把那些银行大鳄完全放过了。
cues.en: and they leave the banksters alone entirely.

cues.zh: 所以，狮子在营地里四处游荡，
cues.en: And so, while lions are roaming the campsite,
the FBI is chasing mice.
What do we need to do?

cues.zh: 在这整件事里我们能做什么？
cues.en: What can we do in all of this?

cues.zh: 我们需要改变那些扭曲的激励机制，
cues.en: We need to change the perverse incentive structures

cues.zh: 正是它们催生了这些反复出现的
cues.en: that produce these recurrent epidemics

cues.zh: 会计操控欺诈的流行病，
cues.en: of accounting control fraud

cues.zh: 而这些欺诈正在把我们的危机越推越深。
cues.en: that are driving our crises.
So we have to first get rid

cues.zh: 那些系统性危险的机构。
cues.en: of the systemically dangerous institutions.

cues.zh: 就是那些所谓的“大到不能倒”的机构。
cues.en: These are the so-called too-big-to-fail institutions.
We need to shrink them to the point,
within the next five years,

cues.zh: 让它们不再构成系统性风险。
cues.en: that they no longer pose a systemic risk.

cues.zh: 眼下，它们就是定时炸弹
cues.en: Right now, they are ticking time bombs
that will cause a global crisis
as soon as the next one fails --
not if, when.

cues.zh: 我们要做的第二件事，是彻底改革
cues.en: Second thing we need to do is completely reform

cues.zh: 现代高管与专业人士的薪酬制度，
cues.en: modern executive and professional compensation,

cues.zh: 他们正是借此收买评估师。
cues.en: which is what they use to suborn the appraisers.

cues.zh: 记住，他们通过薪酬体系
cues.en: Remember, they were pressuring the appraisers
through the compensation system,

cues.zh: 试图制造我们所说的格雷欣动态，
cues.en: trying to produce what we call a Gresham's dynamic,

cues.zh: 即劣质伦理驱逐优质伦理
cues.en: in which bad ethics drives good ethics
out of the marketplace.
And they largely succeeded,
which is how the fraud became endemic.

cues.zh: 我们需要做的第三件事
cues.en: And the third thing that we need to do
is deal with what we call the three D's:
deregulation, desupervision,
and the de facto decriminalization.
Because we can make
all three of these changes, and if we do so,
we can dramatically reduce
how often we have a crisis
and how severe those crises are.

cues.zh: 这对我们的经济绝非小事。
cues.en: That is not simply critical to our economy.

cues.zh: 你们能看到这些危机对不平等造成了什么影响
cues.en: You can see what these crises do to inequality

cues.zh: 以及它们对我们的民主造成了什么影响。
cues.en: and what they do to our democracy.

cues.zh: 它们催生了裙带资本主义，
cues.en: They have produced crony capitalism,
American-style,
in which the largest financial institutions

cues.zh: 是两党最主要的政治献金来源，
cues.en: are the leading financial donors of both parties,
and that's the reason why
even after this crisis,
70 times larger than the savings and loan crisis,

cues.zh: 我们也没有任何实质性的改革
cues.en: we have no meaningful reforms

cues.zh: 在我谈到的三个领域中的任何一个，
cues.en: in any of the three areas that I've talked about,
other than banning liar's loans,
which is good,

cues.zh: 但这只是这种欺诈武器
cues.en: but that's just one form of ammunition
for this fraud weapon.

cues.zh: 他们可以使用的弹药形式还有很多。
cues.en: There are many forms of ammunition they can use.

cues.zh: 这就是为什么我们需要了解
cues.en: That's why we need to learn

cues.zh: 银行家们已经学到的东西：
cues.en: what the bankers have learned:
the recipe for the best way to rob a bank,

cues.zh: 这样我们才能阻止这个配方，
cues.en: so that we can stop that recipe,
because our legislators,
who are dependent on political contributions,

cues.zh: 不会自己主动去做这件事。
cues.en: will not do it on their own.
Thank you very much.
(Applause)
